policy: Byte-preserving copies of explicitly referenced existing small text artifacts. .txt suffix avoids altering raw evidence with formatters. No binaries, recordings, large dumps, dependencies or third-party source vendored. No new execution inferred from archiving. Additional results may be embedded in handoffs.
